purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Port Blair

queries.query: Port Blair official cadastral parcel map land records Andaman Nicobar government GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the South Andaman district land-record map, the Government of Andaman and Nicobar Revenue Department Dweep Bhoomi land-record system, and the official Andaman Bhunaksha viewer link. South Andaman's official tehsil page identifies Port Blair tehsil and its revenue administration. No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

queries.query: पोर्ट ब्लेयर आधिकारिक भू-अभिलेख नक्शा खसरा अंडमान निकोबार
queries.result: Official Hindi South Andaman results identify पोर्ट ब्लेयर तहसील, its villages and revenue administration. The official land-record map and Dweep Bhoomi links are the same first-party cadastral leads; no anonymous parcel geometry or safe native parcel identity was exposed.

registryEvidence.custodian: Department of Revenue, Andaman and Nicobar Islands Administration; South Andaman District Administration and Port Blair tehsil revenue administration
registryEvidence.locality: Port Blair tehsil, South Andaman district
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official district and Revenue Department material evidences a local land-record/map custodian and a Port Blair tehsil scope. It does not establish complete municipal or citywide open parcel geometry coverage.

officialSources.observation: Official South Andaman Hindi page identifies Port Blair tehsil, its revenue area, revenue circles, patwari circles and villages.
Official district portal says Andaman and Nicobar land records are computerized and links the public Land Record Map/Bhunaksha viewer at as.and.nic.in:8080/bhunaksha/.

Official Revenue Department Dweep Bhoomi page describes integration of registration and survey departments for land-record management and links Bhunaksha, but citizen operations require account/login and CAPTCHA.

parcelDiscovery.source: Andaman Bhunaksha / official South Andaman land-record map lead
parcelDiscovery.note: The linked public viewer did not return a usable anonymous HTML/JavaScript/service response during bounded requests. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not used as an absence test.
